title: Creating Group Rules with AI: Human-AI Collaboration in WhatsApp Moderation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through a speculative design study and think-aloud exercises where Indian WhatsApp admins critiqued AI-generated outputs for Western-centric tone, lack of cultural nuance, and inability to appropriately interpret local social contexts and sarcasm.

Thematic analysis of participant interviews and interactions, assessing the AI's perceived limitations and risks when processing non-English content, regional slang, and the code-mixed communication typical of the Global South.
